title: Rename a formatter API across its callers
prompt: Migrate the public formatter API from format_user_name to format_display_name. Update all implementation callers, remove the old public name, and run the tests. Modify only files under src/.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert 'format_user_name' not in Path('src/formatting.py').read_text()

milestones.description: Inspect the formatter definition and its callers before renaming the API.
Use the shell to verify every API caller after the rename.
